          mov r13.z, l(0)
        endif
      endif
    endif
    if_z r7.w
      itof r14.z, r6.w
      mov r15.xz, r4.xxxx
      mov r15.yw, r10.xxxx

      mov r9.w, l(0)

        uge r10.w, r9.w, l(3)
        breakc_nz r10.w
        dp2 r16.x, cb4[r9.w + 0].xyxx, r15.xyxx

        mad r14.xy, r16.xyxx, r13.xxxx, r11.xyxx
        add r11.zw, r14.xxxy, l(0.000000, 0.000000, -0.500000, -0.500000)
        max r10.w, |r11.w|, |r11.z|
        lt r10.w, l(0.500000), r10.w
        if_nz r10.w
          break
        endif
        sample_c_lz_indexable(texture2darray)(float,float,float,float) r10.w, r14.xyzx, t7.xxxx, s1, r12.z
        add r10.w, r7.w, -r10.w
        add r7.w, r10.w, l(1.000000)
        iadd r9.w, r9.w, l(1)
      endloop
      
      // 方向光遮挡阴影计算(原有逻辑进行了一些改动)
      iadd r6.w, r6.w, l(1)
      itof r11.z, r6.w
      mov r6.w, r7.w
      mov r10.w, r9.w
      loop
      
        // 在角色区域使用更高精度的遮挡阴影
        if_nz r21.z
          uge r11.w, r10.w, l(15) // 角色采样次数
        else
          uge r11.w, r10.w, l(3) // 其余部分采样次数
        endif
      
        breakc_nz r11.w
        dp2 r13.x, cb4[r10.w + 0].xyxx, r15.zwzz
        mul r11.w, r10.x, cb4[r10.w + 0].x
        mad r13.y, cb4[r10.w + 0].y, r4.x, -r11.w
        mad r11.xy, r13.xyxx, r13.zzzz, r12.xyxx
        sample_c_lz_indexable(texture2darray)(float,float,float,float) r11.x, r11.xyzx, t7.xxxx, s1, r12.w
        add r11.x, r6.w, -r11.x
        add r6.w, r11.x, l(1.000000)
        iadd r10.w, r10.w, l(1)
      endloop
      //mul r4.y, r6.w, l(0.333333343)
      
      // 将采样结果映射回0~1范围(除以采样次数)
      if_nz r21.z
        div r4.y, r6.w, l(15.0) // 角色部分
      else
        mul r4.y, r6.w, l(0.333333343) // 其余部分
      endif
                      
    endif
    
    //mov r22.w, r4.y // 获取方向光二分阴影因子
    HLSLMov float DirLightSceneShadow = r4.y;
    HLSLSnippet {
        DirLightSceneShadow = (DirLightSceneShadow > 0.5); // 二值化遮挡阴影因子
    }
    
    mul r4.w, r4.y, r4.w
    mul r10.yz, r4.yyyy, r10.yyzy
    mul r4.y, r4.z, r4.w
    mul r17.xyz {min16f}, r2.yzwy {def32 as min16f}, r2.xxxx {def32 as min16f}
    max r17.xyz {min16f}, r0.wwww {def32 as min16f}, r17.xyzx {min16f}

    mul r11.xyz, r10.zzzz, r11.xyzx
    mad r10.yzw, r17.xxyz {min16f as def32}, r10.yyyy, r11.xxyz
    mul r10.yzw, r10.yyzw, cb5[1].xxyz
  else
    mov r10.yzw, l(0,0,0,0)
  endif
else
  mov r10.yzw, l(0,0,0,0)
endif

// 主光源初始化计算==========================================
//HLSL DirLight *= DirLightSceneShadow; // 叠加遮挡阴影
// =======================================================

// 合成光照向量预处理========================================
HLSL float CdotL = dot(CameraVector, DirLightDir);
HLSL float DirBlendVisibilityFactor = DirLightSceneShadow ? saturate(CdotL * 1.0) : 1; // 反向基础光照向量权威因子(为0时完全使用基础向量，为1时完全混合局部向量)，中间CdotL乘法是加权向量与基础向量的混合强度因子，乘的值越大加权向量的影响越大，这里的分支意思是，当存在方向光时，相机向量和方向光向量相背时允许局部光照抢夺光照向量权重
HLSL float TotalWeight = DirLightSceneShadow ? 1 : 0; // 总权重初始化，方向光启用时基础为1以混合方向光向量，否则为0只混合局部光照向量
HLSL float3 LightDirSum = DirLightSceneShadow ? DirLightDir * 1.0 : 0; // 总光照向量初始化，方向光启用时基础为方向光向量以从混合方向光向量开始累积，否则为从局部光照向量开始累积
// =======================================================

ld_indexable(texture2d)(uint,uint,uint,uint) r4.w, r8.xyzw, t10.yzwx

add r9.xyz, -r17.xyzx {min16f as def32}, l(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 0.000000)

mov r11.yw, r10.xxxx
mov r12.x, r11.x
mov r12.y, r10.x
mov r10.yzw, r8.xxyz
mov r3.w, r1.x

// 初始化寄存器
mov r20.xyzw, l(0.0)
mov r26.xyzw, l(0.0)
mov r30.w, l(0.0)

// 初始化参数
HLSL float PointLightSmoothness;
HLSL float AmbientLightIntensity;

HLSL float4 FinalPointLightShadow;

  breakc_z r3.w
  firstbit_lo r4.x, r3.w

    mul r9.w, r9.w, r9.w
    rcp r9.w, r9.w

    mul r9.w, r12.z, r9.w

    //add r26.y, l(1.0), -r26.y // 复制反向光照区域
    
      HLSLMov float3 PointLightDir = -r14.xyz; // 获取正向点光源归一化光照向量(鬼泣原本的向量是反向的，所以这里取反)
      HLSLMov float4 PointLightPos = cb3[r8.w + 0].xyzw; // .xyz: 点光源位置 .w: 点光源半径
      HLSLMov float3 PointLight = cb3[r8.w + 3].xyz; // 点光源颜色
      HLSL PointLight = normalize(PointLight);

      // 检查是否是角色区域 (r21.z != 0)

          if (CharacterMask != 2)
          {
            // ToonNoL=================================
            // 点光源阴影过渡平滑度(Smoothness)
            PointLightSmoothness = 1.0;
            float PointLightToonNoL = GetToonNoL(PointLightSmoothness, Normal, PointLightDir);
            // ===========================================
            
            // 二分点光源光照计算(带距离衰减)
            // 计算灯光向量、距离：点光源位置 - 像素世界空间位置
            float dist = length(PointLightPos.xyz - WorldPos.xyz); // length(点光源位置 - 像素世界空间位置)
            
            // 计算标准化距离衰减：1 - saturate(distance / radius)
            float DistanceAttenuation = 1 - saturate(dist_Remake / PointLightPos.w);
            DistanceAttenuation *= SpotLightMask;
            PointLight *= DistanceAttenuation; // 添加距离衰减
            
            PointLight *= PointLightToonNoL; // 点光源ToonNoL光照(无场景遮挡阴影、无自阴影)
          }
      }

            add r13.w, r15.z, l(1.000000) // 累积采样结果
            iadd r14.w, r14.w, l(1)
          endloop

          else

        endif

          if_nz r9.w
            imul null, r9.w, l(5), cb3[r8.w + 4].x
            imad r12.z, cb3[r8.w + 4].x, l(5), l(5)
            mul r15.xyzw, r6.yyyy, cb3[r12.z + 2561].xyzw
            mad r15.xyzw, r6.xxxx, cb3[r12.z + 2560].xyzw, r15.xyzw
            mad r15.xyzw, r6.zzzz, cb3[r12.z + 2562].xyzw, r15.xyzw
            add r15.xyzw, r15.wxyz, cb3[r12.z + 2563].wxyz
            div r16.xyz, r15.yzwy, r15.xxxx
            mad r18.xy, r16.xyxx, l(2.000000, 2.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), l(-1.000000, -1.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000)
            max r16.w, |r18.y|, |r18.x|
            lt r16.w, r3.z, r16.w
            if_nz r16.w
              mul r18.xyzw, r6.yyyy, cb3[r9.w + 2561].xyzw
              mad r18.xyzw, r6.xxxx, cb3[r9.w + 2560].xyzw, r18.xyzw
              mad r18.xyzw, r6.zzzz, cb3[r9.w + 2562].xyzw, r18.xyzw
              add r15.xyzw, r18.wxyz, cb3[r9.w + 2563].wxyz
              div r16.xyz, r15.yzwy, r15.xxxx
              mov r9.w, cb3[r9.w + 2564].y
            else
              mov r9.w, cb3[r12.z + 2564].y
            endif
            add r15.y, r16.z, cb3[r12.z + 2564].w
            mad r15.zw, r16.xxxy, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 2.000000, 2.000000), l(0.000000, 0.000000, -1.000000, -1.000000)
            max r15.z, |r15.w|, |r15.z|
            lt r15.z, l(1.000000), r15.z
            lt r15.x, r15.x, l(0.000000)
            or r15.x, r15.x, r15.z
            lt r15.z, r15.y, l(0.000000)
            or r15.x, r15.z, r15.x
            if_nz r15.x
              mov r14.z, l(1.000000)
            endif
            if_z r15.x
              utof r18.z, r9.w
              mov r9.w, l(0)
              mov r15.x, l(0)
              loop
                uge r15.z, r15.x, l(3)
                breakc_nz r15.z
                mul r15.zw, cb3[r12.z + 2564].xxxx, cb4[r15.x + 0].xxxy
                dp2 r19.x, r15.zwzz, r12.xyxx
                mul r15.z, r10.x, r15.z
                mad r19.y, r15.w, r11.x, -r15.z
                add r18.xy, r16.xyxx, r19.xyxx
                sample_c_lz_indexable(texture2darray)(float,float,float,float) r15.z, r18.xyzx, t7.xxxx, s1, r15.y
                add r15.z, r9.w, -r15.z
                add r9.w, r15.z, l(1.000000)
                iadd r15.x, r15.x, l(1)
              endloop
              mul r14.z, r9.w, l(0.333333343)
            endif
          else
            mov r14.z, l(1.000000)
          endif
        endif
      endif
      mul r15.xyz, r14.zzzz, cb3[r8.w + 3].xyzx
      
      HLSLMov float PointLightShadow = r14.z;
      HLSLSnippet {
      PointLightShadow = (PointLightShadow > 0.5); // 二值化遮挡阴影因子
      PointLightShadow *= saturate(PointLightToonNoL * 2); // 这里需要叠加NoL之后累积时才能避免阴影被反面的光照覆盖，乘两倍再标准化是因为乘一倍的话，角色正面和反面同时有光照时中间交接区域会因为NoL过渡变暗，看起来比较脏，所以提高一下NoL整体亮度，把过渡偏移到偏暗面的方向
      }
      
      HLSL FinalPointLightShadow.x = max(saturate(PointLightToonNoL * 2), FinalPointLightShadow.x);
      HLSL FinalPointLightShadow.y = max(PointLightShadow, FinalPointLightShadow.y);
      
    else
      add_sat r12.z, r1.y, cb3[r8.w + 4].w
      mul r15.xyz, r12.zzzz, cb3[r8.w + 3].xyzx
      
      HLSL PointLightShadow = 1; // 部分光源没有投影，从这里直接赋值为1
      HLSL FinalPointLightShadow.z = max(PointLightShadow, FinalPointLightShadow.z);
      HLSL FinalPointLightShadow.w = max(DistanceAttenuation, FinalPointLightShadow.w);
    endif
    
    HLSL LightDirBlend(LightDirSum, TotalWeight, DirBlendVisibilityFactor, DistanceAttenuation * 1, PointLightDir);
    
    mul r8.w, r4.z, r12.w
    mul r12.zw, r4.yyyy, r14.xxxy
    mul r14.xyz, r9.xyzx, r12.wwww
    mad r14.xyz, r17.xyzx {min16f as def32}, r12.zzzz, r14.xyzx
    mad r14.xyz, r8.wwww, r2.yzwy, r14.xyzx
    mad r13.xyz, r15.xyzx, r14.xyzx, r13.xyz
    
    HLSL FinalPointLight += PointLight; // 累积点光源光照
    // 混合累积阴影因子，当同时存在有投影光源和无投影光源时，在投影部分取无投影光源的距离衰减因子来自然过渡，避免了直接将阴影覆盖的情况，也避免了通过加权混合过渡会突兀跳变的问题，还减小了保留阴影导致的部分极端情况的光照不自然问题(有投影阴影从墙后给角色打上阴影，现在这么做代价只是亮度减半，如果不这样做还想保留阴影则光照会直接消失，非常奇怪，之后看看有没有办法完全解决这个问题，这段话还在就是没解决)
    HLSL FinalPointLightShadow.w = FinalPointLightShadow.x + FinalPointLightShadow.z > 1 ? FinalPointLightShadow.y + FinalPointLightShadow.w * (1 - FinalPointLightShadow.y) : FinalPointLightShadow.y + FinalPointLightShadow.z;
    
    mov r6.w, r7.w
  endloop
  mov r10.yzw, r13.xxyz
  //HLSL FinalPointLightShadow.w = FinalPointLightShadow.x == FinalPointLightShadow.y;
  
endloop
mul r0.xyz, r10.yzwy, l(0.318309873, 0.318309873, 0.318309873, 0.000000)
max r0.xyz, r0.xyzx, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000)
min o0.xyz, r0.xyzx, l(65536.000000, 65536.000000, 65536.000000, 0.000000)

// =====================
// 如果是角色，将光照输出设为0
// r21.z已经是角色的标识（1表示角色，0表示非角色）
// 使用movc进行条件选择
movc o0.xyz, r21.z, l(0.0), o0.xyz
// =====================

// 光照角色二分阴影计算===================================================
HLSL float3 FinalLightDir = TotalWeight > 0 ? normalize(LightDirSum) : 0;
HLSL float3 MainColor = DirLightSceneShadow ? DirLight : length(FinalPointLight) > 1 ? normalize(FinalPointLight) : FinalPointLight; // 基础光照颜色(以是否直接受方向光照来判断是否直接使用方向光颜色)
// 合成向量光照计算
HLSLSnippet {
float MainNoLSmoothness = 0.02; // 主NoL明暗过渡软度
float FinalNoL = GetToonNoL(MainNoLSmoothness, Normal, FinalLightDir); // 计算主NoL光照
float FinalLightShadow = FinalNoL * max(FinalPointLightShadow.w, DirLightSceneShadow); // 混合光照阴影
float3 FinalLight = lerp(MainColor * 0.2, MainColor * 1.0, FinalLightShadow); // 控制亮暗面基础颜色
FinalLight = DirLightSceneShadow ? FinalLight + FinalPointLight : FinalLight; // 叠加局部光照颜色
FinalLight *= 5; // 光照强度
FinalLight += -1; // 光照偏移(我这里主要是用于把最低亮度从0压到负，因为在鬼泣5的大部分光照shader中，自发光在没有光照的情况下才是默认颜色，也就是原始颜色，所以直接叠加到用自发光材质的角色身上，会导致暗处看起来过亮，所以这里本质上是为了调整暗部最低亮度，可以按自己感觉调整，我这里默认-1)
FinalLight *= CharacterMask; // 只保留角色部分
}
DXBCMov r18.xyz, FinalLight

add o0.xyz, o0.xyz, r18.xyz // 叠加角色二分光照并输出
// ===================================================================

//mul r21.z, r21.z, l(10.0)
//mul o0.xyz, r18.xyz, l(10.0)

//mul o0.xyz, r16.w, l(1.0)

//mov o0.xyz, l(0.0)

ret
// Approximately 556 instruction slots used
